name: Blissey
description: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Fairy Wind
moves.description: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes. This lowers the target’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining kiss that restores the user’s HP.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.description: The user restores its own HP.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.
